name: Beet red colour, concentrate (from sugar beet)
source: Illustrative dried beet-juice colour concentrate (E162-style natural colour): proximate (per kg) water 50 g, sugars 850 g (the beet's own sucrose, the bulk carrier), betanin pigment 10 g, ash 90 g.
notes: Betanin (the red pigment responsible for the colour) is modelled by its real molecular formula, C24H26N2O13, but is a small minority of the concentrate's own mass — commercial beet colour is predominantly the beet's own sugars and minerals with betanin as the minor colorant, not purified pigment. origin/colour.ts extracts this from sugar-beet.json's own registered composition via splitByProfile.
